purpose: Measure actual one-shot native MLX Klein phase ownership, preserving exact pre-clipped decoder pixels. No model admission, accepted edit, or app dependency change.
policy: Materialize prompt embeddings, release text encoder and prompt cache, then complete all four native denoising steps. A callable lease releases the compiled predictor closure, compiled cache and transformer before native VAE decoding. Clear only free cache at phase transitions; no resizing, tiling, changed precision, changed learned tensors, altered prompt/seed or peak reset during inference. Instance is consumed and must reload for another generation.
memory_scope: MLX active allocation high-water, free cache, OS process physical-footprint high-water and RSS are different measurements. Do not sum them or claim total device peak. libproc OS footprint can differ from MLX logical allocation accounting. Shared M5 Max 128GiB macOS27 observations, no physical16/24/32GiB tier proof, no p50/p95, no speedup claim, no admission budget change.
cache_control: Additional release-small-cache cases impose an explicit1,000,000,000-byte MLX free-cache cap before loading; upstream respects the host cap. No app configuration or environment variable added.
input_scope: Paint is an explicit combined manual990K-pixel rectangle on Auto SDR native1024x1536, not automatic People mask policy. Scene is canonical pre-WB linearRec2020 RAW native1024square, supplied shared signed-asinh encodedf32 without PNG quantization; source contains5367channels>1 and0negativechannels. This is not negative photographic fixture qualification.
